name: Shatter / dismemberment

request.text: Single dry close positional game sound effect. Immediate attack, self-contained fade, no voice, no scream, no breath, no words, no music, no ambience, no weapon firing, no reverb. A forceful ice-bone fracture blast with a dense short crunchy crack and many small sharp frozen splinters scattering. More explosive than the ordinary small cryo limb break.
